patterns: APPSC asks single-fact applications: city with longest summer daylight (Srinagar), city that never gets vertical Sun rays (north of 23.5N), latitude with maximum seasonal contrast.
Other PSCs: Christmas in Australia = summer, smallest noon shadow on 21 June, midnight Sun at Arctic Circle on 21 June.
Trap themes: distance (perihelion in January) vs tilt as cause; rotation vs revolution.
App MCQs lean on A-R and match items about mechanism; PYQs are short date/place recall.
